name: Search Checklists
description: Find a checklist on a particular board or card by name. [See the documentation here](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-boards/#api-boards-id-checklists-get) and [here](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-cards/#api-cards-id-checklists-get).

configurable_props.name: type
configurable_props.label: Type
configurable_props.description: Whether to search boards or cards for the checklist.

configurable_props.name: boardId
configurable_props.label: Board
configurable_props.description: The Trello board you wish to select

configurable_props.name: checkItems
configurable_props.label: Check Items
configurable_props.description: Whether to display checklist items in the result. Select `all` or `none`.

configurable_props.name: checkItemFields
configurable_props.label: CheckItem Fields
configurable_props.description: Fields to include in the results. `all` or a list of: `name`, `nameData`, `pos`, `state`, `type`

configurable_props.name: fields
configurable_props.label: Fields
configurable_props.description: Fields to include in the results. `all` or a list of: `idBoard`, `idCard`, `name`, `pos`. Eg: `idBoard,idCard,name,pos`. Eg: `all`.
